# `oaap report`

the weekly report (RFC-0083).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap report [--tenant TENANT] [--week WEEK] [--week-of WEEK_OF]
                   [--send] [--day DAY] [--at AT] [--on] [--off]
                   {show,run,ledger,settings}
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `--tenant TENANT` | a tenant's label (default: the node) |
| `--week WEEK` | show: which week, e.g. 2026-W46 |
| `--week-of WEEK_OF` | run: a day (YYYY-MM-DD) in the week to report (default: last week) |
| `--send` | run: also mail it now |
| `--day DAY` | ledger: write this day (YYYY-MM-DD); settings: mon..sun |
| `--at AT` | settings: HH:MM (local time) |
| `--on` | -- |
| `--off` | -- |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `show` | yes |
| `run` | yes |
| `ledger` | yes |
| `settings` | yes |
